description: This is a shell script for testing git svn globbing refspecs and related SVN/Git repository operations. It contains functions for setting up SVN repositories, performing checkouts, creating branches/tags, and validating globbing patterns in SVN and Git configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure with a descriptive label.
